sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
body:
> Weird.Baby launched on scope and on schedule. f(Ump) = 100%
  > Operations has hands-on-the-ball. Ownership is on track (T-6).

sections.label: DETAILED REPORT
body: Launch was successful, with two anomalies;
1) We had an alarm condition resulting from a massive, unexpected, surge of incoming data within minutes of turning on the preflight server. (ALARM: Incoming Server Load >= 1K * nom.)

2) Multisource swarm-payloads precluded IP/Domain blocking.
  -

The decision to resume was determined to be low risk, reversible, and a real-world stress test.
  Data surge ended abruptly and coincident with Weird.Baby launch.

> The remainder of the day was completely uneventful.
  > Weird.Baby uptime - 100%, no further anomalies.
  > ADDED PAGE - W.B/Robots added (to track what happened, just for a few days)
     HASH: 982056&363=$^6/Tx=0...........SUCCESS!
